fufu 0.16.1 is a patch release: one fix to how a named push records open work.

## Fixes

- [`ff push`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/push/) with a named branch that is not checked out saved the invoking checkout's tree, index, and base as the target's open change and timeline. Switching to the target could resume apparent deletions or overwrite its parked edits. Push notes now belong to the invoking checkout's branch; published and seen refs still record each target independently. Work already affected under v0.16.0 is not reconstructed by updating: with no parked edits, `ff restore --all` on the branch restores its committed files, and genuine parked edits come back from a retained pre-push capture. The [stacked-branch guide](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/guides/stacked-changes/#inspect-local-work-after-a-named-push) covers both.
